testcase.name: a pace measured for less than fifteen minutes is freshly measured
a settled Doppler pace on a fresh fix at the last point is a plain walking time with no degrade
a walker more than 50 m off the track has the hop added and the estimate degraded
before the data bar the default pace is used and the estimate reads at least
fewer than ten surviving points degrades
a track that is mostly network fixes degrades on that and on being under-measured
the far-from-track degrade holds through the band until the hop drops below 45 m
an origin waypoint adds its leg without degrading, and a track with no origin is not degraded for it
no usable points withholds the estimate rather than measuring a path that is not there
a stale fix degrades, and a lost fix or no fix withholds the estimate
the estimate does not move when a long stop is inserted with the same distance remaining
an excluded tenth of the stored points degrades the path as under-measured, and less does not
